summary: War correspondent Wilfred Burchett (left) and an unidentified journalist outside a hut during armistice negotiations. Born in Clifton Hill, Vic in 1911, Burchett worked as a war correspondent during the Second World War. Developing an interest in Communism, he visited China in 1951.
